description: This file defines the ClaimExpenseDecorator class, which provides methods to wrap around a ClaimExpense entity, facilitate interaction with ClaimService, and set or retrieve related claim request and expense type data.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for ClaimExpense entity, providing methods to associate claim requests and expense types, and retrieve formatted date and claim service instances.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a ClaimExpense object.

methods.name: setClaimRequestByRequestId
methods.description: Associates a ClaimRequest with the ClaimExpense based on a request ID.

methods.name: getClaimRequestById
methods.description: Retrieves a ClaimRequest entity using a request ID.

methods.name: getClaimService
methods.description: Returns an instance of the ClaimService.

methods.name: setExpenseTypeByExpenseTypeId
methods.description: Sets the expense type on the ClaimExpense based on an expense type ID.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the claim expense formatted as 'Y-m-d'.
